projectName: Sample World — Worldwide Terrain Realism and Camera Navigation Stabilization
goal: Make navigation stable and terrain believable across the world; preserve accepted landscape and verify before publication.

milestones.title: Identify and reproduce camera discontinuities
milestones.objective: Identify and reproduce the reported discontinuities in bounded cases.
acceptanceCriteria: Bounded reproducible cases and their limitations are preserved

milestones.title: Explore and compare correction candidates
milestones.objective: Compare bounded correction alternatives without mutating product code.

milestones.title: Final camera correction qualification
milestones.objective: Determine whether the candidate or narrow alternative preserves terrain-appropriate camera height, obstacle visibility and safe clearance at actual relevant terrain.
acceptanceCriteria: Source-bound and, when possible, real-terrain height tradeoffs checked
Specific recommendation or specific unresolved safety/experience issue returned

milestones.title: Implement bounded camera correction
milestones.objective: Implement the qualified delta only after the required authorization.
acceptanceCriteria: Qualified source delta tested against protected invariants

milestones.title: Visual and mobile regression qualification
milestones.objective: Verify the corrected camera experience in actual traversals.
acceptanceCriteria: Real-world terrain coverage and user visual review checked

milestones.title: Authorize and publish camera repair
milestones.objective: Publish independently qualified accepted candidate through approved channel.
acceptanceCriteria: Authorized exact release and live verification

milestones.title: Attribute visible terrain boundaries
milestones.objective: Identify source causes of polygonal materials and hard ecological edges at real positions.
acceptanceCriteria: Representative real-coordinate witnesses and bounded repair spec
